procedures.title: Frustum Streaming

candidate_steps.text: When you enable frustum streaming for a player, the server also streams instances within a frustum shape matching the player's camera view, extending well beyond the normal streaming radius.
- **Frustum**: the camera-view pyramid, active only when frustum streaming is on for that player.
Roblox might adjust this allocation in the future if games commonly use both frustum streaming and replication foci and the frustum needs higher priority.
On devices with reduced graphics quality or low frame rates, the engine might disable frustum streaming automatically.
- **Not applicable to non-streaming experiences**: if your experience does not use instance streaming, all instances are already present on the client and frustum streaming has no effect.

references.excerpt:
**Statut :** passages candidats extraits de la source, **non validés** dans Roblox.

**Source lue :** https://github.com/nightcycle/quick-part  
**Contenu :** GitHub README  
**Passages candidats :** 5

### Passages et paramètres repérés

- Press **Play (F5)** to animate the real BaseParts/models on the left and their QuickPart versions on the right: five primitives changing properties, 100 moving cubes, a rotating/scaling 26-part arch, two birch trees with separate trunks and transparent leaf cards, and a woodland scene with a round tree, pine, bush, ferns, grass and boulder.
- Use Play, not the server-only Run mode, for the client animation.
